location.arrival_instructions:
We are located at the Azrieli Sarona Tower

121 Menachem Begin Road, 45th Floor
Tel Aviv, Israel

Guests arriving by car are welcome to park at the "Azrieli Sarona Tower parking lot."
From there, walk to the lobby and present your ID to receive a visitor badge and elevator access to the 45th floor. A parking exit card will be provided at the end of your visit.

Please note: A valid photo ID is required to enter the building.

details.name: What You’ll Do
details.value:
Responsibilities:

  • Research emerging agentic technologies and uncover new exploits, attack vectors and risks. From initial exploitation to impact.
  • Build tooling, harnesses, and test frameworks to scale attack discovery and make research repeatable. And contribute to internal red team infrastructure.
  • Investigate the surrounding ecosystem, not just the model. This includes: plugins, connectors, MCP servers, orchestration frameworks, and different types of infrastructure. Mapping how weaknesses in one component can develop into full compromise.
